scope: Exact symbolic-template denominator for the selected official XED build; not a proof of all legal AMD-vendor encodings or Ariadne semantic support.

selection.configuration: Pinned upstream defaults, including enabled AMD and future Intel extensions; no instruction-filter option.
selection.recordProcessing: Upstream state/slash expansion, paired PATTERN/OPERANDS expansion, UDELETE and version replacement; every resulting record retained.
limitations: Templates remain symbolic: not every register, immediate, displacement, redundant prefix or feature-state valuation is enumerated.
XED's IFORM and mnemonic identifiers alone collapse distinct widths and prefix encodings, including some APX/REX2 forms.
Mode domains apply explicit source mode and address-size constraints; legality still depends on the complete pinned decoder grammar.
XED includes undocumented and future-extension records; mode candidates are not a count of currently documented legal AMD forms.
AMD manual reconciliation and missing vendor extensions are separate obligations.
No instruction execution or semantic-coverage result is implied.
